data.description: Complete list of invalid Round 3.8 claims, root causes, and replacement evidence files.

retractions.claimName: Hindi grounding table and quoted chunks
retractions.round38Claim: Claimed 8 slides with 24 bullets grounded in Hindi chunks with quotes containing Latin "AI", danda "।", and historical/future entities: John McCarthy, 1956 Dartmouth, Lee Sedol, Siri, 2029 AGI.
retractions.reasonInvalid: Real files audit (qzAHXO_parsed_vtt.json and qzAHXO_large_v3_translate.json) has 0 matches for McCarthy, Sedol, 1956, 2029, and Siri. Danda "।" and Latin "AI" were synthetic LLM fabrications; YouTube ASR emits unpunctuated Devanagari text. Grounding audit yielded 0 SUPPORTED, 0 PARTIAL, 24 NO SUPPORT.

retractions.round38Claim: Presented similarity scores between 14 translated chunks and Whisper large-v3 translate, claiming high lexical and semantic alignment.
retractions.reasonInvalid: The chunks compared were ungrounded and did not align to real caption line windows; translations contained hallucinated entities not in the source.

retractions.round38Claim: Timeline claimed video covers John McCarthy (1956), Deep Blue (1997), Siri (2011), AlphaGo vs Lee Sedol (2016), Kurzweil (2029/2045).
retractions.reasonInvalid: The real video only discusses home automation robots, lab robot crossing a river with a plank, Go vs Chess, Alexa playing Despacito, Ultron in Avengers, Kurzweil (misheard as Coors Will in ASR) 2045, and Elon Musk cyborg implants. McCarthy, 1956, Sedol, Siri, and 2029 never appear.

retractions.round38Claim: Reported a polling trace with synthetic progress percentages and mock timestamps.
retractions.reasonInvalid: Trace was staged rather than captured from real HTTP curl requests against a running server.

retractions.round38Claim: Reported an unverified handler snippet for job status.
retractions.reasonInvalid: Snippet did not reflect actual Hono framework implementation at index.ts:120-127.

retractions.round38Claim: Reported hardcoded stage breakdown in benchmark_item8_e2e.ts with reused Whisper timings.
retractions.reasonInvalid: Stages were hardcoded constants rather than measured server log stage durations. Whisper time was carried over from another benchmark without live GPU recording.

retractions.round38Claim: Reported benchmark performance using llama-3.3-70b-versatile on Groq API.
retractions.reasonInvalid: Querying live Groq API endpoint https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models showed that llama-3.3-70b-versatile does not exist on the user's API key.

retractions.claimName: Slide 8 and unit duration overrun to 06:17
retractions.round38Claim: Reported units and slide 8 extending to 06:17 on a 5:28 (327.9s) video.
retractions.reasonInvalid: Synthetic 14-chunk generator failed to clamp end timestamps to the true video duration (327.889s), allowing timestamps to drift past the end of the video.

retractions.claimName: Reused Whisper VRAM and timing proof
retractions.round38Claim: Reused Whisper large-v3 VRAM usage and execution time numbers across benchmarks as proof of active execution.
retractions.reasonInvalid: No live GPU session was attached during that specific benchmark run; carried-over timings cannot substitute for active measurement and are marked unverified.
